# Saturn

> Saturn is a secure MCP (Model Context Protocol) gateway between AI agents and the tools they call. It centralizes access, enforces argument-level permissions, requires human approval for sensitive actions, and keeps a complete audit trail.

Saturn Technology Project by Prism Capital LLC. Saturn App, the desktop agent, is MIT licensed (copyright Prism Capital LLC). Saturn MCP is the gateway. Updated 10 October 2026.

## English

- [Saturn](https://saturn.technology/): Secure MCP gateway for AI agents. One endpoint, tool sets, argument-level policy, human approval, and audit.
- [What Saturn is](https://saturn.technology/#faq): Definitions of Saturn, an MCP gateway, supported clients, the difference from an API gateway, credential handling, and Saturn App pricing.
- [Saturn MCP](https://saturn.technology/mcp): The MCP server agents talk to. Connect existing MCP servers, build tool sets, write policies, and point every agent at one endpoint.
- [Saturn App](https://saturn.technology/app): Free, MIT-licensed desktop AI agent for macOS and Windows. Runs locally with your models, files, and MCP servers.
- [Pricing](https://saturn.technology/pricing): Saturn App is free. The MCP gateway is included in Pro and Enterprise, which are coming soon.
- [Pricing questions](https://saturn.technology/pricing#faq): What is free, what Pro adds, personal versus organization accounts, and Enterprise pricing.
- [Book a demo](https://saturn.technology/demo): Request a walkthrough of Saturn with your own tools.

## 中文

- [Saturn](https://saturn.technology/zh): 企業級 AI Agent 的安全 MCP Gateway。
- [關於 Saturn](https://saturn.technology/zh#faq): Saturn 的定義、MCP Gateway、支援的用戶端、與 API Gateway 的差別、憑證處理，以及 Saturn App 是否免費。
- [Saturn MCP](https://saturn.technology/zh/mcp): Agent 實際連線的 MCP Server。連接既有 MCP Server、組建工具集、撰寫政策。
- [Saturn App](https://saturn.technology/zh/app): macOS 與 Windows 上免費、MIT 授權的桌面 AI Agent，在本機運行。
- [方案與定價](https://saturn.technology/zh/pricing): Saturn App 永久免費。MCP Gateway 包含在即將推出的 Pro 與 Enterprise。
- [常見問題](https://saturn.technology/zh/pricing#faq): 免費範圍、Pro 內容、個人與組織的差別、Enterprise 計價。
- [預約展示](https://saturn.technology/zh/demo): 用你自己的工具預約一次導覽。
